recentlyCompleted.title: Fix 13 review findings from bulk session
Constructor-to-test-mock drift detection in standards gate
recentlyCompleted.description: Add a new check type to flow-standards-gate.js: when the diff shows a constructor signature change (added/removed dependency injection parameters), auto-identify corresponding *.spec.ts files and verify their mock/provider setup matches the new signature. Flag mismatches as MUST_FIX. Implementation: parse constructor parameters from the diff, find test files by convention (*.spec.ts in same directory or __tests__/), compare mock providers against constructor params. This is systematic and predictable — the backend forgot 6 times across 6 modules. Source: Backend mistake #4, process gap #2.

recentlyCompleted.title: Dispatch verification enforcement in workspace manager mode
recentlyCompleted.description: In workspace manager mode, after any response containing 'dispatched', 'sent to worker', 'forwarded' — verify a Bash tool call with the dispatch URL exists in the same turn. If missing, flag before the response completes. Implementation: add a PostToolUse or Stop hook check in the workspace manager rules. Scan the response text for dispatch-claim keywords, then verify corresponding tool_use blocks exist. This prevents the 'narrate without execute' failure class where the manager describes sending work but never actually sends it. Source: Manager mistake #1 (~15K tokens wasted on phantom dispatch).

recentlyCompleted.title: Cross-repo enum verification in workspace mode
recentlyCompleted.description: When workspace mode detects a decision involving type/enum mapping between repos (frontend↔backend), mandate: dispatch a grep/read to BOTH repos for actual enum values, display them side-by-side, THEN present the mapping to the owner. Never allow 'A maps to B' without verified evidence of both A and B. Implementation: add detection logic to the workspace manager decision flow — scan for keywords like 'maps to', 'rename to', 'corresponds to' when the decision involves cross-repo types. Add a 'crossRepoEnumVerification' rule to workspace config. Source: Manager mistake #5 (DECISION-7 axis mismatch — payment cadence vs compensation model).

recentlyCompleted.title: Skill prompt compression — continuation mode for sequential tasks
recentlyCompleted.description: Create a lightweight 'continuation dispatch' mode for /wogi-start. When a worker receives its 2nd+ task in the same session, inject a compressed skill prompt (~2-3K tokens) instead of the full ~15K. The compressed version contains: acceptance criteria, files to change, boundary declarations, quality gates, verification commands. It skips: routing logic, triage tables, examples, edge case documentation, all the 'how to route' sections. Implementation: create wogi-start-continuation.md (~2-3K compressed version), add session-task-count tracking to flow-session-state.js, modify the routing hook to select full vs compressed prompt based on count. Verify the compressed prompt still triggers all mandatory gates. Source: Frontend token efficiency observation (120K tokens on routing across 8 tasks).

recentlyCompleted.title: Decision-authority framework — config-driven engineering vs product decisions
recentlyCompleted.description: Add a first-class config.decisionAuthority section: { engineering: 'agent-decides', infrastructure: 'agent-decides-report-after', productBehavior: 'owner-decides', security: 'auto-fix-report-after', maxOwnerQuestionsPerBatch: 5 }. Before presenting any decision to the user, classify it against this framework. If 'agent-decides' → decide and report. If 'owner-decides' → present. Enforce maxOwnerQuestionsPerBatch. Wire /wogi-decide to update these categories when user says 'from now on just fix those yourself'. Implementation: add config schema, add classification logic to wogi-start.md routing, create flow-decision-authority.js, update config.schema.json. Source: Manager mistake #4 (12-question flooding), process gap #4.

recentlyCompleted.title: Scope-confidence gate — audit assumptions before multi-day plans
recentlyCompleted.description: Add a scope-assumptions audit before Step 1.5 (Generate Specification) for L0/L1 tasks: (1) extract every assumption the plan depends on (new tables, new models, new APIs, new services), (2) for each assumption, attempt codebase verification (grep for existing implementations), (3) for unverifiable assumptions, present to user with the question 'does X already exist?' BEFORE planning proceeds. This is NOT the same as clarifying questions (Step 1.2) — this specifically targets scope-inflating assumptions. Implementation: add Step 1.45 to wogi-start.md between explore and spec. Source: Manager mistake #6 (7-10 day plan collapsed to 1 day with one question).
